source.mode: read-only work list plus numeric event-comment signals

meta.privacy: Public-safe aggregate. Raw work titles, comment bodies, member names, raw IDs, contact data, salary amounts and banking data are excluded.
meta.decisionBoundary: Read-only planning aid. It does not assign people, change levels, close work, approve delivery, or trigger payroll.

estimateGuide.high: 8 筆以上同工作或同類型實際耗時回報。
estimateGuide.low: 1–2 筆實際耗時回報，只能暫估。
estimateGuide.baseline: 尚無可用評論回報，使用規劃基準值。

gaps: 工作狀態與指派涵蓋率取自 2026-08-11 即時唯讀快照；工時估計仍沿用最近可用的分類評論樣本。
每位工讀生本週可用工時仍需另由排班或時數表提供；本摘要不以事件活動量代替可用工時。
